_readme: What appears in a room once you've finished tidying it.
This is the cheapest immersion in the game: walking back through a room
you cleaned an hour ago and finding a cat asleep in it does more for
'this is a place' than a feature would. The room stops being a score and
Keyed by room id from rooms.json. `at` is a % position in the room.
Props are decorative only — no pointer events, nothing to collect.
A room with no entry here simply gets none.
